about: Each eval runs one prompt through `claude -p --plugin-dir plugins/jud` in a fresh workspace (run.py). `setup` builds the workspace: files copied from the repository, recordings made beforehand against the mock server, edits applied after recording. `mock` starts mock_system_one.py for the run; without it the base URL points at a closed port, so no eval can reach a real API. `checks` are verified by run.py; `expectations` are graded by a reader of the reply and the transcript. `new_files` lists the files a run may create; any other new file in the workspace fails the run. `announce_before_record` fails a run whose transcript has no `Recording N requests` line before its first `jud record` call.

expectations: Reports each question's accuracy with its 95% interval and says 7 cases are too few to support a bar
Triages both misses on the case `receipt` with a cause from the skill's table and a proposed action
Says the desk miss at confidence 0.40 is under the gate's 0.45 bar, so the gate defers it (the bar's job)
Counts labels per outcome and names at least one coverage gap (an option, level or `false` few or no cases label)
Ends with ranked next steps and changes no file
Gives a decision per gate (accept, keep, or re-run) with a one-line reason
Keeps tone's written bar instead of the proposed 0.00, says why (a bar of 0 on 6 cases defers nothing), and gives the kept gate a note saying so
Writes the tuning block as `jud tune` printed it, without inventing a value
Shows each gate's acts, defers and accuracy when acted before and after
Passes on the thin-data warning in plain words and says how many more cases would make the bars trustworthy
Says before recording that the run will make 48 requests, to which backend and with which model (in a text message, or as the record call's description)
Never prints the API key's value
Reports `recorded 48, kept 0` and the model the recordings name
Offers /jud:eval as the next step
Notices that 30 recordings already exist and says only about 18 requests are new
Runs record without --refresh, so the 30 recordings are kept
Reports `recorded 18, kept 30`
Flags `refund-request`'s queue label (account) as probably wrong, proposing billing, and cites the case's own note
Flags `status-down`'s needs_reply label (false) as probably wrong: an outage report needs a reply
Identifies the billing/account confusion (upgrade-plan, seat-invoice, trial-end) as overlapping outcomes or an ambiguous criterion, and proposes sharpening the criteria (which means re-recording)
Puts the low-confidence urgency misses (adjacent levels, around 0.5 to 0.6) on the bar or on overlapping levels, not on the labels
Does not change any label or file itself

Does not accept queue's proposed 0.80 as is: it covers under a third of the cases (15 of 48, or 10 of 36 after a hold-out split), and the misses it absorbs include a wrong label and the billing/account overlap
Shows the coverage trade-off of a lower --target-accuracy for queue (it ran tune again, or read the table)
Gives a decision table: gate, primitive, now, proposed, decision, reason
Shows the exact edit it would make as a diff that jud check accepts (tuning under spec), with its measured after, and offers to apply it, without changing any file in the project
Writes a tuning set and a held-out set whose cases together are the original 48 with no case in both, every queue option in both
Tunes on the tuning set and reports the held-out gate numbers as the ones to expect
Edits the rubric in place, keeps its comments (rewording only words the tuning makes false), and keeps or adjusts queue's bar with a reason instead of taking a bar that covers a handful of cases
Shows before and after
